headline: Executive order sets a policy that federal agencies should not limit Americans' lawful speech, according to its title.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order deals with free speech and what it calls federal censorship. It appears to direct the federal government to stop or avoid actions that limit what people can lawfully say. No official summary was provided, so the specific rules, steps, and deadlines are not described here.

who_it_affects.how: They would likely face limits on actions seen as restricting people's lawful speech.

who_it_affects.group: People who post or share content online
who_it_affects.how: The order appears aimed at how the federal government deals with speech, including speech on online platforms.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed January 20, 2025; executive orders usually take effect when signed unless they say otherwise.
